# Vibe Bolvig Hyldgård

Vibe Bolvig Hyldgård is an epidemiologist with a PhD affiliated with the Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut (the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute) [^src1]. She is listed as a member of the steering group responsible for the ADHD database, a body whose membership spans all five Danish regions, relevant professional societies, patient organizations, and the Quality Institute itself [^src1]. Her role reflects the institute's involvement in overseeing the quality and methodology of the national ADHD database, which documents diagnostic and treatment pathways for children, adolescents, and adults with ADHD, including regional variation in the use of a pathway marker for refuted suspicions, covering the period 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025 [^src1].

The available record for Vibe Bolvig Hyldgård is thin: she appears in a single listing of steering group members and their professional affiliations [^src1]. No further biographical details, claims, or timeline events are documented in the corpus.
